name: Rout
description:
When you knock a foe unconscious, you may use your reaction and spend 5 Hope to give you and your allies a temporary +1d to all attack rolls.

If you or an ally knocks another foe unconscious before the end of your next turn, the bonus increases to +2d and continues from round to round.

The bonus ends if, at the end of your turn, neither you nor an ally has knocked a foe unconscious in the last round.
